cwe.cwe_name: External Control of File Name or Path

real_world_analog.summary: Arbitrary file upload in WSO2 API Manager: the filename parameter traversed directories during upload, writing outside the target directory (CWE-73).
real_world_analog.fix: Confine the write to the base name inside the export directory; this case uses an equivalent containment (base name plus realpath containment check).
real_world_analog.verification: CVE number and summary confirmed via web search on 2026-11-01; the app in this case is original synthetic code.

note: Self-contained oracle case. Proven directly with effect='canary_write'. No upstream repo/commit applies because the code is original synthetic code written for this case.
